title: DiffuPrimer: conditional discrete diffusion for primer-pair design
description: Source code, two historical CNN checkpoints, frozen mouse-gene benchmark data, candidate and full-reference screening evidence, and reproduction scripts. Includes single-seed mechanism controls separating trained scores, frozen-score sampling and iterative network updates. Reference sequences and third-party tools retain their original terms. Manuscript preparation is ongoing; no journal publication is claimed.
